newsitem.title: UK: GKN gains as Laing rates "trading buy".
newsitem.headline: GKN gains as Laing rates "trading buy".

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc rose on Friday, recovering from recent weakness as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing issued a "trading buy" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
The stock was up 13-1/2p at 10.10-1/2p stg by 1103 GMT in moderate volume of 988,374 shares, extending a rebound since it set a six-month closing low of 983p on December 27.

GKN shares suffered a sharp setback last month when a U.S. jury ruled that the company should be liable for damages in a lawsuit brought by a group of franchisees and GKN said it could face a bill of up to $554 million.

Analyst Daniel Bevan at Laing said the stock had been oversold on the U.S. ruling and that there were hopes the size of the award could be reduced on appeal. He said an appeal court ruling on the case was expected later this month.

Bevan also said GKN should benefit from an Italian government rebate scheme to encourage motorists to trade in old cars, launched on Monday. He said Italy's Fiat was GKN's biggest customer in continental Europe.
Other auto parts stocks were also firm, with LucasVarity Plc up 1p at 223 and T&N Plc up 2p at 173.
